title: jasper-deploy environment manifest
description: The declarative desired-state manifest consumed by reconcile.ps1 (a Terraform-for-JasperReports). It lists the repository resources that SHOULD exist on the server. reconcile.ps1 GETs each resource to decide create (absent) / update (present, label differs) / ok (present, label matches), prints a plan by default, and -- only with -Apply -- delegates to the matching jasper-deploy script (datasource->create_datasource.ps1, domain->create_domain.ps1, report->deploy_report.ps1 -Overwrite, dashboard->build_dashlets.ps1 -Compose).

resources.description: The desired repository resources. Reconciled in array order, so list a datasource before the reports/domains that reference it.

items.description: One desired resource. The 'type' discriminator selects which per-type fields are required (validated by the allOf/if-then branches below). All types share 'type', 'uri', and an optional 'label' (the label is also what reconcile.ps1 compares against the live label to choose ok vs update).

type.description: Resource kind. Selects the create/deploy script reconcile.ps1 calls on -Apply.

uri.description: Repository URI of the resource, e.g. /datasources/postgis_34_sample. Used both for the existence GET and as the create/deploy target. Must start with '/'.

label.description: Human-readable label. reconcile.ps1 compares it to the LIVE label to decide ok (match) vs update (differs); omit it and a present resource is always treated as 'update'.

description.description: Optional resource description, passed through to the create/deploy script.

then.description: Datasource resource -> create_datasource.ps1. Fields map to that script's parameters. Defaults (jdbc/localhost/5432/postgis_34_sample/postgres) come from create_datasource.ps1 when omitted.

connectionUrl.description: (jdbc/aws) Full JDBC URL. If omitted it is built from dbHost/dbPort/database.

driverClass.description: (jdbc/aws) JDBC driver class. Default org.postgresql.Driver (the PostgreSQL driver ships with JRS).

jndiName.description: (jndi) JNDI resource name, e.g. jdbc/foodmart. Required when dsType is jndi.

beanName.description: (bean) Spring bean id. Required when dsType is bean.

beanMethod.description: (bean) Method on the bean that returns the datasource/connection.

serviceClass.description: (custom) Custom data-source service class. Required when dsType is custom.

properties.description: (custom) Free-form key/value property map forwarded as -Properties.

subDataSources.description: (virtual) Ordered alias -> member datasource URI map forwarded as -SubDataSources; each alias becomes a schema prefix in the virtual (Teiid) datasource.

region.description: (aws) JRS region value = the AWS ENDPOINT HOST, e.g. us-east-1.amazonaws.com (NOT the bare 'us-east-1' code).

then.description: Domain (single-table semantic layer) resource -> create_domain.ps1. Binds a JDBC datasource to an uploaded schema.xml.

schemaFile.description: Path to the Domain schema.xml (from scaffold_domain_schema.py). Relative paths resolve against the manifest's directory.

dataSourceUri.description: Repository URI of the EXISTING JDBC datasource the Domain reads from. The schema's jdbcTable datasourceId must resolve to this datasource's leaf.

then.description: Report (reportUnit) resource -> deploy_report.ps1 -Overwrite. Supply EITHER a prebuilt jrxml path OR a scaffold spec (materialized via scaffold_jrxml.py before deploy).

jrxml.description: Path to a prebuilt .jrxml to deploy. Relative paths resolve against the manifest's directory. Mutually exclusive with 'scaffold'.

dataSourceUri.description: Repository URI of an EXISTING datasource the report binds to. Omit to fall back to jrs.config.json's dataSourceUri.

scaffold.description: Scaffold spec passed to scaffold_jrxml.py to GENERATE the jrxml before deploy. Use instead of 'jrxml'.

name.description: Report base name -> --name and the generated <name>.jrxml file.

outDir.description: Local output dir for the generated jrxml. Default <manifestDir>/report.

query.description: Inline SQL SELECT -> --query. Must not begin with WITH (the JRS validator rejects leading CTEs). Mutually exclusive with queryFile.

queryFile.description: Path to a .sql file holding the query -> --query-file. Relative paths resolve against the manifest's directory.

then.description: Dashboard resource -> build_dashlets.ps1 -Compose. The dashboard is built from a SEPARATE build manifest (see references/manifest.schema.json).

manifest.description: Path to the build_dashlets manifest (the report/dashboard build + grid spec). Relative paths resolve against the environment manifest's directory. Note: recomposing an EXISTING dashboard may require deleting it first (teardown_dashboard.ps1).
